video_title: Jrue Holiday Media Availability | Oct. 5, 2026 | Portland Trail Blazers

quotes.speaker: Jrue Holiday
quotes.summary_phrase: Jrue Holiday on Scoot Henderson's defensive potential and intensity
quotes.excerpt: once Scoot get out there he's a dog, so that that that wasn't a joke.
quotes.quote: I wasn't joking. I think people see once Scoot get out there he's a dog, so that that that wasn't a joke. He's strong, he's quick. He can guard one through four and he's strong enough to push the five around if he's down there. So I was dead serious. There's much to teach Scoot, just got to give him some time.
quotes.social_post: Jrue Holiday is high on Scoot Henderson defensive potential saying he is a dog who can guard one through four and is strong enough to push around centers

quotes.speaker: Jrue Holiday
quotes.summary_phrase: Jrue Holiday evaluates Scoot Henderson's performance in training camp
quotes.excerpt: Scoot's been playing really well. Doing a lot of everything, knocking down threes, getting to the paint.
quotes.quote: Scoot's been playing really well. Doing a lot of everything, knocking down threes, getting to the paint, putting pressure on the rim, and then again picking up full. I think he's playing well.
quotes.social_post: Jrue Holiday says Scoot Henderson has been playing really well in training camp noting his ability to knock down threes and put pressure on the rim

quotes.speaker: Jrue Holiday
quotes.summary_phrase: Jrue Holiday on what Dennis Smith Jr. brings to the team
quotes.excerpt: Dennis Smith Jr. is a crash out. So he's going to play hard, he's going to give you energy.
quotes.quote: Dennis Smith Jr. is a crash out. So he's going to play hard, he's going to give you energy. You always know when he's on the court because he impacts the game when he's on the floor.
quotes.social_post: Jrue Holiday praises the energy Dennis Smith Jr brings to the court saying you always know when he is out there because he impacts the game

quotes.speaker: Jrue Holiday
quotes.summary_phrase: Jrue Holiday on the Portland Trail Blazers' defensive identity
quotes.excerpt: I think it's just containing players, keeping people in front of us, making them not have just one dribble.
quotes.quote: I think it's just containing players, keeping people in front of us, making them not have just one dribble, line drives. We have Deandre Ayton back there, Robert Williams back there to be able to protect us and really good perimeter players.
quotes.social_post: Jrue Holiday says the Blazers defensive identity will be built on containing players and keeping them in front of the defense with Ayton and Williams protecting the rim

quotes.speaker: Jrue Holiday
quotes.summary_phrase: Jrue Holiday on standout performers in training camp
quotes.excerpt: Jayson Tatum's played well, Young Blood's played well, Scoot Henderson's played well.
quotes.quote: Jayson Tatum's played well, Young Blood's played well, Scoot Henderson's played well. Michael's just had a baby, but he's been knocking down shots, controlling the paint, being physical. Deandre Ayton too, Robert Williams has been on top of the rim, making great plays, same thing defensively. So I mean I think everybody's been doing, I think it's been a good camp.
quotes.social_post: Jrue Holiday highlights training camp standouts including Jayson Tatum Scoot Henderson and Deandre Ayton noting that the team has had a good camp

quotes.speaker: Jrue Holiday
quotes.summary_phrase: Jrue Holiday on defensive adjustments from last season
quotes.excerpt: Sometimes situational, sometimes where we need to pick me up on on defense and a little better energy.
quotes.quote: Sometimes situational, sometimes where we need to pick me up on on defense and a little better energy. Obviously Deandre Ayton, myself, Scoot Henderson, we're all going to be able to do that. Matter of fact, Deandre Ayton's been trying to lock up too. He's been doing a good job of sliding his feet, being strong, not letting people get in the paint, so they will be okay.
quotes.social_post: Jrue Holiday says Deandre Ayton has been doing a good job defensively in camp focusing on sliding his feet and keeping opponents out of the paint

quotes.speaker: Jrue Holiday
quotes.summary_phrase: Jrue Holiday on the team's offensive philosophy
quotes.excerpt: Everybody knows Damian Lillard, everybody knows Scoot Henderson, everybody knows Damian Lillard. We're taking those three, it's a lot of buckets.
quotes.quote: Everybody knows Damian Lillard, everybody knows Scoot Henderson, everybody knows Damian Lillard. We're taking those three, it's a lot of buckets and I think they're going to be hard to stop. But with that, guys like myself, Robert Williams, Deandre Ayton can wide up with shots too and wide up with shots always the best shots.
quotes.social_post: Jrue Holiday believes the Blazers offense will be hard to stop with Damian Lillard and Scoot Henderson leading the way
